input.summary: Insert an IP/data paragraph giving AP a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Kubient deliverables, and limiting any Kubient licence in AP data to processing to provide the Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no rights in deliverables or in our data, and the only licence to us (paragraph 2) is limited and revocable. We have added a short provision at our fallback position: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for our business, and any Kubient licence in our content and data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

ops.text: Kubient retains ownership of its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform. Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense, for Customer's business, all deliverables provided by Kubient hereunder other than the Auction Platform. Any license granted to Kubient in the Content, Requests, and any other data or materials belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is limited to processing the same solely to provide the Services.
